headline: Central Sectors Churn with Fresh Turnovers as Western Clashes Subside
war_summary: Nevish Line's rapid base-flipping subsided into an uneasy tactical lull with no base handovers in the last two hours, though accelerating attrition continues to bleed both armies. In contrast, renewed fighting has flared in Mooring County, where contested clashes over The Wind Hills registered two immediate turnovers to leave one stronghold in neutral ruins alongside eleven Warden bases. Farther east at Stlican Shelf, fresh friction erupted around Briar, yielding two quick base transfers to hand Wardens a lone outpost against eight Colonial redoubts. Linn of Mercy remains an inferno of attrition, devouring over twenty-six hundred casualties in two hours as Outwich Ranch and Lathair saw two further base shifts, keeping two forts under Warden rule, eight Colonial, and one neutral. In Marban Hollow, five consecutive base exchanges contested Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, maintaining a tense split of four Warden, three Colonial, and one destroyed redoubt. Meanwhile, Weathered Expanse logged three fresh base captures and neutralizations at Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest, leaving three garrisons per side and three in abandoned ruin.
